reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it is described as a formal Coinbase product presentation demonstrating trading features and participation flows in the Coinbase app. The material is characterized as informational rather than investment advice or a recommendation, and the available video evidence identifies no guaranteed returns, credential requests, deceptive redirection, completed losses, or misrepresented outcome.

citations.quote: Stock trading is now available on Coinbase. So let's see how this works.
I open up my Coinbase app where I can now see a dedicated section for stocks on the trade tab.
After just a few taps, I can buy Nvidia using USDC, while I'm also earning best-in-class rewards.
these contracts will be available to traders on both our simple and advanced trading platform outside the U.S., enabling trading with up to 20 times leverage.
all US traders can now trade Futures and Perpetual Futures in an intuitive, easy-to-use interface, directly on Coinbase.

opening.argument: The presentation links a concrete financial action to a reward claim: viewers are shown buying Nvidia with USDC and are told they are also earning “best-in-class rewards.” That is not merely discussion of markets; it presents an easy, few-taps path to acquire an asset while receiving an emphasized benefit. The call to use the platform, fund the purchase with USDC, and transact is therefore paired with a reward-oriented inducement. The material does not specify the reward’s amount, eligibility, duration, or conditions, leaving the attractive benefit more prominent than its limitations.

citations.quote: After just a few taps, I can buy Nvidia using USDC, while I'm also earning best-in-class rewards.
I open up my Coinbase app, where I can now turn this on.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling this a product demonstration does not remove the solicitation. The demonstration specifically shows a purchase funded with USDC and places “best-in-class rewards” alongside that action. The disclaimer says only that the content is not investment advice; it does not explain the reward, qualify the benefit, or negate the promotional pairing. Nor does the absence of a reported loss establish that the inducement is not misleading.

This content, and any information contained therein, does not constitute a recommendation by Coinbase to buy, sell or hold any security, financial product or instrument referenced in the content.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The quoted material shows a platform feature, not a free or unusually easy reward. It says only that the presenter was earning “best-in-class rewards” while buying Nvidia; it does not promise viewers a specified payout, guaranteed return, or reward for registering or depositing. The accompanying description expressly says the content is informational and not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold an instrument.

opening.argument: The risk signals accumulate around asset acquisition: the service advertises access to “millions of assets,” including assets “as soon as they are created,” and permits purchases through USDC, a bank account, or a debit card. It also promotes early access to projects before launch and presents a sale that drew $269 million in allocation requests. This combination encourages rapid participation in newly created or not-yet-launched crypto assets through ordinary payment rails, while the presentation emphasizes breadth, ease, and scale rather than asset-specific safeguards or valuation limits. That is a materially promotional risk profile, even without an explicit promise that every asset will appreciate.

citations.quote: you can trade millions of on chain assets as soon as they are created
balance, or I can even buy Solana assets directly with a bank account or a debit card.
enabling traders to get early access to the most popular projects in crypto before they launch.
customers requesting $269 million dollars in allocations.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The defense treats the absence of a guaranteed return as dispositive, but the concern is the scale and ease of the acquisition pitch. The material pairs newly created assets and pre-launch access with bank or debit-card purchasing, then highlights substantial allocation demand. A general informational disclaimer does not supply asset screening, valuation, or loss context for those specific opportunities.

citations.quote: you can trade millions of on chain assets as soon as they are created
enabling traders to get early access to the most popular projects in crypto before they launch
customers requesting $269 million dollars in allocations.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: These excerpts establish availability and participation mechanics, not appreciation, listing gains, dividends, or any promised return. Early access is not itself a claim that tokens will increase in value, and the allocation-request figure describes demand rather than an outcome for buyers. The material does not state that buyers received profits or that any token appreciated.

citations.quote: enabling traders to get early access to the most popular projects in crypto before they launch.
customers requesting $269 million dollars in allocations.

opening.argument: Although presented as an update and demonstration, the material functions as a coordinated promotion for participation across multiple crypto products. It says viewers can trade millions of on-chain assets immediately, buy them with a bank account or debit card, and obtain early access to projects before launch. It then describes the platform as the best place for an issuer to launch and calls the offering “pretty cool.” Those are steering signals, not neutral explanation: the audience is repeatedly directed toward acquiring tokens and joining launches through one branded platform.

I can even buy Solana assets directly with a bank account or a debit card.
enabling traders to get early access to the most popular projects in crypto before they launch.
This is pretty cool, guys. Come on!
Coinbase is now the best place for any asset issuer to launch.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The formal presentation setting strengthens rather than defeats the promotional reading: the speaker demonstrates the app, highlights purchase routes, calls the token-sale feature “pretty cool,” and declares Coinbase the best place for issuers to launch. The informational disclaimer addresses advice, but it does not change the repeated invitation to acquire assets through the platform or establish that the promotion is balanced.

citations.quote: This is pretty cool, guys. Come on!
Coinbase is now the best place for any asset issuer to launch.
I can even buy Solana assets directly with a bank account or a debit card.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The presentation promotes ordinary platform services, but promotion alone does not establish a token scam. The quoted language does not promise appreciation, dividends, listing gains, or profit from acquiring any token. The description instead identifies the content as informational and expressly disclaims a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold the referenced instruments.
